reviews.text: [h1]简洁的设计，依旧的炫酷[/h1] 起先看见《几何竞技场2》我还以为又是一款类幸存者游戏，当亲自上手时与了解更多后才理解本作是对其一代的延伸与扩展，为一款肉鸽射击游戏。其概念要比幸存者早很久。几何图形并不复杂，将此概念设计为游戏，自是新颖而且美丽大方。成型后的打击特效虽然不够光污染，但还算炫酷，数值不算爆炸，但成长的体验感依旧满满。 [h1]轻松出击，愉悦上头[/h1] 游戏搭配与流派十分多样，武器，机体，模组，难度各种各样均为模块化的自定义添加，同时通过升级获取经验可以解锁更多，亦可点点天赋，属性化数值化的提升通过层层反应，而局内也通过多样化的道具与能力产生奇妙组合，尽力保证每一局的新鲜感。搭配轻松的音乐，很容易就沉浸在游戏当中，刷刷刷几十分钟。 [h1]是国产EA，但值得放心[/h1] 开发者十分热情与活跃在Q群，B站当中，视频之中亦可见次次更新的努力。坦诚不做作，热衷答复，让玩家值得信赖。18元定价性价比良好，尽管目前内容不算多，但相信日后会不断完善。毕竟前作正是保持着这种积极的态度与更新频率才有好评如潮的评价。 [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]

你说得对，但是“噶2”是一款令人振奋的子弹射击游戏，从头到尾都会让你坐在座位边上。凭借其流畅的游戏性、富有挑战性的敌人和令人满意的枪战，这款游戏是任何该类型粉丝的必玩游戏。随机生成的关卡增加了一层额外的可重放性，而各种武器和升级使体验新鲜而令人兴奋。像素艺术图形迷人而身临其境，声音设计增加了身临其情的体验。总的来说，“噶2”是一款梦幻般的游戏，肯定会为任何玩家提供数小时的娱乐。好玩，你可以在游戏里找到novadrift的影子(太空竞技场实锤） 2023/12/5更新：辣鸡游戏！手机上玩的卡的一B!毫无优化！

[h1]《几何竞技场2》EA上线，模仿几何？创造几何！[/h1] 《几何竞技场2》是一款有独特几何元素的动作类肉鸽游戏，并且在很多方面都有值得一提的创意。 [quote=Lem0n juice] 笔墨写春秋，挥毫描秀色； 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44125219-Lem0n-juice/]Lem0n-juice [/url]~ 我们致力于游玩各类游戏并给出自己的意见供大家参考，欢迎加入我们的大家庭~[/quote] [h1]独特抽象的几何元素[/h1] 如果说《吸血鬼：幸存者》、《土豆兄弟》的画风很简陋，那么《几何竞技场2》就可以说是抽象。虽然将几何元素融入游戏不是首创，但在肉鸽类游戏中应该是相当少见。 在这款游戏中玩家操纵的角色（机体）、小怪、boss都为简单的几何图形，或者由三角形、圆形、矩形、棱形等组合在一起。这个游戏的基本逻辑就是敌人组合越复杂、体积越大，它的伤害和血量就越高。 整个区域全部由几何图形构成，这很容易导致玩家审美疲劳。在几何竞技场2里，小怪按照了一种类似公式化的固定轨迹运行，它不会刻意去追踪玩家，并且遇到边界自动死亡；boss则有各种特性，诸如追踪玩家、产出更多小怪。 [h1]机体、武器与模组选择搭配[/h1] 游戏目前有四种机体（可理解为角色职业）、四种武器。四种机体：游侠、狙击手、毁灭者、转化体，每种机体都有独特属性，以及按空格键可以释放主动技能。例如游侠可以像鼠标光标处突进；毁灭者可以以自己为中心造成爆炸，同时对自己造成伤害。 四种武器：守护者、炮手、追踪者、左轮枪，左键普通攻击为发射子弹或榴弹，当然可以选择开启自动攻击；每个武器都有独有的主动技能，右键使用。例如守护者的技能为在四周生成一次性的四面环绕屏障，对敌人造成伤害。所以说，如果开启自动攻击，玩家则需要wasd进行走位，鼠标右键与空格分别控制武器技能与机体技能。 4加4的选择确实使玩法相对单一，即使游戏为每一个机体和武器设计了独特的模组选择，并且模组可以多选，这在一定程度上增加了重复可玩性。但是给我重复游玩的动力实在比较小，考虑到游戏刚EA发售，并且作者承诺会增加机体与武器，勉强可以接受目前4加4加模组的搭配。 [h1]常规的动作类肉鸽玩法[/h1] 在属性数值方面，《几何竞技场2》基本是模仿了前人作品，攻击力、暴击、幸运等都延用了下来。每层战斗结束后从三个奖励中选择一个，部分奖励兼有buff与debuff，这些奖励普遍设计比较用心。每层能刷新一次奖励，不使用则可以叠加至后面轮次。 战斗结束后可获得天赋点，在局外选择提升角色属性与天赋属性。此天赋系统相对容易养成，能让玩家更快以最高属性继续游玩。 战斗结束后可获得天赋点，在局外选择提升角色属性与天赋属性。此天赋系统相对容易养成，能让玩家更快以最高属性继续游玩。 [h1]抽象几何，但有质感[/h1] 游戏中玩家、敌人乃至子弹均由几何图形构成，但这并不代表这款游戏制作粗糙。通过清晰的画风、对几何图形的阴影表现，游戏中的图形并没有“轻飘飘”的，它们反而很有质感。 在战斗界面，我们可以看到相当简洁的ui设计。左上角为蓝条，下面为血条，右下方是剩余敌人量——这种大方的设计在我这里是加分项。另外游戏中音效相当出色，比较有击打感；bgm相对普通，我一般会关掉自带bgm自己挑选背景音乐。值得一提的是游戏中大多操作通过键盘都能完成，熟练后能快速选择奖励与开始游戏，为老玩家提供了相当好的手感。 [h1]游戏的社区建设[/h1] 游戏中包含一次同时挑战多少层的设计，你将可能一次性面对多于常规十几倍的敌人。局外也设置了排行榜，可以看到自己总分数的排名，当然我这种手残玩家只能在游戏更新刷新榜单时短暂上前十。《几何竞技场2》在免费试玩阶段就收获了大量粉丝，玩家交流群已有一千多人，且制作者在群内相当活跃，也积极听取建议和bug反馈，调整较快。 [h1]一个优秀的独立游戏创作者[/h1] 游戏价格不贵，它的第一代也在steam上好评如潮。游戏唯一的制作者在公告中表示，由于一代过于追求更新速度，很多平衡性没有做得很好。他明白几何竞技场2目前是一个半成品，不过承诺后续会添加更多的内容，并且修复bug。我个人非常期待制作者正在构思的宠物养成系统，总的来说我很推荐《几何竞技场2》。
强度和稀有度和颜色互相不挂钩简直醍醐灌顶，完全是不同以往的构筑体验。
非常好肉鸽 爱来自第一世代轻污染帧率坠落爱好者

Honestly, price aside, this game feels like a strict downgrade to the previous game. With games like halls of torment, vampire survivors and even Death Must Die coming up, Geometry Arena is just missing a lot of marks. The endless stream of upgrades you get are actually pretty vapid and you'll find yourself picking the same upgrades no matter what loadout you're doing, not to mention that the different loadouts don't actually seem to change the way you experience the game much. Interesting concept, nice and basic, but the replayability is poor for a game that's supposed to be specifically based around replayability, it just doesn't quite match up to other games in the genre. I've got 4 hours in this game and I've basically seen everything, matches always end with a boss that has a ludicrous amount of health smacking me in the face while being faster than me or by me merely dying because I cannot see what's going on.

I love Geometry Arena 1, I can see the improvements for this on the QoL side and that the dev has improved considerably since, but unfortunately the game severely lacks content currently, it has a very solid foundation to build upon, but I can't recommend it until there's more content. This has less content than 95% of other Early Access games.

After the first game, I was hoping there would at least be a translator hired on. The ability to parse the language and read what each ability does is abysmal. There are typos, nonsensical text, and even residual Chinese characters in nearly every single description of every single powerup and menu in this game. Additionally, I really don't know why this is even a sequel and exists at all since it doesn't even improve on any aspects of the first game, and is instead a coat of paint and shift to the side rather than its own separate title. In fact, I'd say the first game is better than this one in the menus, upgrades, and gameplay. I'm honestly more confused than anything. What is the point? Why make the same game twice? Why not actually fix anything from the first game? Sure, there is a good foundation and it plays fine and works, but this is just a reskin of the previous game, with all the same problems. Cheap as chips and almost fun for a minute, but if I were you I wouldn't bother.

写于5.8h,2024.05.08 暂时还不推荐这款游戏,技能树不完善,输出成长乏力,perk之间没有联动,缺乏build空间,敌人刷新过快,角色性能太弱. 看得出作者野心很大,但没有跳出一代的框架,反而删去不少精华部分,肝度不减的同时降低了爽度. 值得一夸的是美术改了,没那么晃眼了. 下面是给作者的一点建议 1.从这代角色模组的变化可以看出来作者想在角色技能上面下功夫.但说实话,作者菌努力的方向有问题,这游戏一代就是挂机刷子游戏,二代不少玩家就冲着这个来的,作者菌在主动技能上下功夫就有点教人玩游戏的感觉了,给刷子游戏增加操作量是很离谱的行为.如果要在技能上下功夫,应该重心放在被动效果上,最好是独一无二的特殊/强力效果(代价也要很大,局内无法获得).举个例子,一代和二代我最喜欢玩的角色都是剑宗,就因为除了剑宗没有第二个角色能耍剑. 2.不要把某一套build和角色绑定,一代我很讨厌的一个点就是榴弹,因为正常情况下玩榴弹流只有机枪手和炮手有游戏体验,因为其他角色的榴弹发射能力≈0.作者菌完全可以把激光,导弹,榴弹之类的子弹下放到局内build里,让没有发射手段的角色可以后天得到这些子弹.原本的角色可以重新设计特殊的buff或者子弹. 3.还有就是局内成长问题,现在这个升级的面板很恶心,经常刷不出想要的特性,缺少普适的特性填充奖池.同时刷新次数有限,跳过之后不保留升级次数,导致局内build极难成型,再加上技能联动差,数量少.直接导致输出乏力,游戏体验下滑.如果要改,我建议增加'排除'次数来删除这局不想要的perk,增加选择界面选项数量,加强perk间联动效果 4.难度,我觉得这种刷子游戏难度上来了打不动怪是很正常的,但问题在于怪太多了.这代整体节奏都快,角色射程普遍偏短,结果就是层数高了清不完小怪被围殴致死,是在是高血压.而且实色子弹很挡视野,本来就看不清这下直接看不见,怪的血量成长也是离谱,二十来层就开始刮痧,属实劝退.

我是本作一代上百小时的老玩家，也在二代两年前开启EA以来一直关注本作，大概能算得上一个老粉——而这也是为什么我对这一作的感觉更为暧昧，所以本篇测评更多从两代之间的改动来聊。 游戏最大的特征当然就是在这里“一切皆几何”，所有的敌人都是简单的几何碎块，并且有着各自的运动规律，包括其发射的“子弹”也只是速度更快大小更小的几何体，可以通过攻击消解。当然，这套简陋的机制包装只是为了这个游戏近乎变态的数值爆发一个合理一些的前奏，这个游戏中随处可见伤害+100%，✖️120%等词条，而每个回合，视你选择的难度而定，可以获得最多十项升级，这就会在你的前期堆出一个夸张的强度窜升的成长曲线了。 本代进行了不少改动，比如分离炮台和机体，对一些imba的项目禁用了无限堆叠，绑定关卡难度和关卡结束后拿到的奖励轮次，来规避不受控的经济系统设计。从一个学院派的立场来看，本作似乎做对了所有事情，它并没有颠覆一代的基础玩法，我们所熟悉的“双刃剑”“急速火炮”等增益项目也完全按照一代的规格和数值保留，但是似乎就是感觉不太对，不再是曾经那种选择任意套路，在运营后都能无限的模式了，也没有那么强的爽点反馈，只是在提心吊胆中等待某一关怪物的强度量级超越你的输出量级。 游戏进行了这么多数值调优，想必也是为了不出现一代“玩什么都是无限流”，后期体感毫无区别的问题。但是开发者似乎太过想要规避一代那种后期同质化的局面，却导致游戏的核心数值成长魅力也在一定程度上被抹杀了。 [table][td]欢迎关注鉴赏家[url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45519015/]“无趣评测”[/url][/td][/table]
怎么说呢，游戏的底子还不错，游戏性也还可以，但是游戏内容太少了，没有持续玩下去的动力，作者要是能增加一些场外升级（比如装备系统）或是多开几张地图（有不同敌人、技能、特性等）就好了，目前只能给到6/10分

[quote]A review copy was provided by the developer.[/quote] [quote]Follow my Curator page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41363546-Fruit-N-Doggie-Reviews/]Fruit N Doggie Reviews,[/url] so you can be updated whenever I post a new review.[/quote] [h1]Overall Rating - Seriously Flawed ★★☆☆☆[/h1] [h1]First Impressions[/h1] At the highest difficulties, twin-stick shooters can make for exhilarating moments as you fire back at overwhelming forces trying to blow you to pieces. That's the general expectation I had from Geometry Arena 2 (GA2), but I thought it might be on the more casual side with its difficulty. A game I could mindlessly play, instead of needing to crank up the adrenaline and chug some gamer fuel. I was sort of correct, not expecting it to reach the extent it did though. [h1]Gameplay[/h1] There's various options you can tweak, but at its core, this is a twin-stick shooter where there isn't really an end goal. You don't have a final floor to reach, or an inspiring boss battle to conquer. This harkens back to the idea of earning high scores, where you can toggle different settings to increase your multipliers, surviving as long as possible through a gauntlet that will at some point overwhelm you. Each wave that you manage to beat earns you a choice between three upgrades, increasing your strength at the trade-off of enemies becoming more potent as well. My main problem with this title is that after a certain point, you're not really playing it anymore. The balance between your attacks and enemy spam gets pretty out of whack, while the screen is so overloaded, I can't even tell what's happening. At that point, there's no value in me controlling my character. It took me less than two hours to run into this problem, with the upgrades I chose making it so I'd survive waves without even having to move. To be fair, I have to reach this broken state on any given run, but the end result will always be a point where I couldn't meaningfully play if I wanted to, as indicated by my one screenshot. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3654635244 [h1]Controls[/h1] As someone who's strongly a controller advocate, I don't find the choice of inputs to be ideal. Why would my attacks and abilities be relegated to shoulder buttons when the face buttons are available? Thankfully you can toggle auto-attack as an option, and I don't see any reason not to. To be fair, a weapon or two would have strategic benefit to timing it right, but if you get a solid build, it seems to remove that necessity. Otherwise, I'd say the control scheme is fine, as long as you don't overwhelm the game, and cause it to start lagging. [h1]Story[/h1] Shapes never seem to be able to get along together, as they're always squabbling in these minimalist kind of games. Regardless, I didn't see any plot or story elements behind this title. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3654634980 [h1]Visuals[/h1] Considering how frantic the action gets on screen when you combine too many power-ups and effects together, it's a good thing the design isn't anymore complicated than basic shapes and figures. Otherwise, enemies with proportions, animated frames, and other visual effects would cause the entire game to lag much earlier. Although the number of enemies on screen is a factor, the real problem is how many bullets, projectiles, and other attacks you launch as you increase how many triggers can cause them to activate and build on top of each other. However, with how simple the visuals are, the fact that the game lags merely from playing it in a reasonable fashion doesn't really reflect well on how it's been created. The human eye can't detect everything occurring anyways, so it's not a benefit to have this much chaos taking place. [h1]Sound Design[/h1] With what the developer was aiming to achieve, I'd think they'd want several more songs, or greater variety in the tunes, in order to keep those noises from getting too grating. I found that when I was listening to the background music, it got irritating fairly quickly. Certain sound effects can also be pretty annoying, such as if you create a safety zone and keep having your full health bar replenish endlessly. Ultimately, this is pretty easily resolved by just playing some background tunes of your own instead. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3654634610 [h1]Pros[/h1] 🌟 You can personalize the color options for your attacks, your pet, and enemies. I altered that immediately, and it made distinguishing between everything very simple. 🌟 The right combination of upgrades make you feel powerful, even if you aren't doing much. [h1]Cons[/h1] ❌ Some abilities seem to have a detrimental effect, making your build much weaker. For example, boomeranging bullets, as the range is cut in half so they can circle back on nearby enemies. I've taken this before, but it only seems to hamper me. ❌ The different weapons and builds don't alter how you play as dynamically as I'd have hoped. It will at the beginning, but it falls apart as you progress, more or less turning into the same thing each time. ❌ Earning all the achievements is more a matter of patience, willingness to grind, and attending to particular goals, instead of having to be good at the game. [h1]Tips[/h1] 🔍 I'm not a min-max guru, but I liked options that increased how many projectiles I had, bullet pierce, and rebounds. Obtaining numerous power-ups automatically and having better grenades also seemed a powerful avenue to go with. 🔍 To reduce lag, toggle off visual effects, like all the particles. 🔍 You don't really need to move all that much in this game. [h1]Final Thoughts[/h1] Simply enough, I think the developer took the idea of a game that can play itself too far. There's a section in the Settings that lets you auto-run GA2 to the extent it'll replay itself after dying, without you having to engage at all. After a certain point, I definitely toggled those options and allowed this title to grind through monotonous sections, unlocking achievements for me, most of which revolve around surviving long enough to obtain a good chunk of XP points. Because the gameplay breaks down to the point you can't really engage with it meaningfully, there's not much incentive for actually playing yourself, which is a cardinal sin for any game. This works well as a test of concept or prototype, but I would say it fails as a Steam release, and wouldn't recommend getting it. 🔸 Full Review Geometry Arena 2 strips the twin-stick shooter genre down to its core and builds depth through clarity rather than complexity. There’s no narrative framing, no progression padding, and no distractions — just responsive controls, readable enemy patterns, and escalating mechanical challenge. Combat is immediate and fair. Enemy behavior is clearly communicated, projectiles are visually distinct, and player movement feels tight and predictable. This clarity allows difficulty to scale naturally, with survival depending entirely on positioning, awareness, and execution rather than upgrades or meta progression. What makes Geometry Arena 2 stand out is its commitment to simplicity as a strength. Different modes emphasize different skills — endurance, reaction time, spatial awareness — encouraging improvement through repetition and mastery. Success feels earned because the game never introduces mechanical shortcuts. The minimalist presentation reinforces this design philosophy. Clean visuals ensure information is never lost in visual noise, and the soundtrack supports focus rather than overwhelming it. The result is a tightly designed arcade-style experience built around pure mechanics. 🧠 Why It Stands Out Geometry Arena 2 succeeds through focused mechanical design. Skill-Driven Gameplay: Performance depends on player execution, not unlocks. High Readability: Clear visuals support fair, learnable difficulty. Underrated Depth: Simple systems reveal long-term mastery. Geometry Arena 2 doesn’t attempt to reinvent the genre — it refines it. For players who value mechanical honesty and clean design, it’s a strong example of how much depth can exist within simplicity.

Geometry Arena 2 is a compelling fusion of twin-stick shooting, roguelite progression, and deep character customization that takes the simple geometric combat formula and transforms it into a surprisingly rich experience. Developed and published by 011 Games, the title builds upon the foundation of its predecessor with a much larger emphasis on build creation, long-term progression, and player freedom. While its minimalist visuals may initially suggest a straightforward arcade shooter, the game quickly reveals layers of complexity that make it far more engaging than its appearance might imply. The gameplay revolves around surviving increasingly dangerous waves of geometric enemies inside compact arenas filled with projectiles, hazards, and escalating challenges. Movement and shooting are responsive and intuitive, allowing players to focus on positioning and strategy rather than struggling with controls. As the battlefield becomes more crowded, the action grows increasingly intense, creating a satisfying sense of pressure that constantly pushes players to improve. The visual presentation relies on bright effects, clean shapes, and explosive particle displays, giving every encounter a vibrant arcade-like energy while maintaining clarity even during the most chaotic moments. One of the game's strongest features is its extensive customization system. Players can combine different weapons, bodies, modules, and support companions to create unique combat styles. The sheer number of possible combinations encourages experimentation and rewards creative thinking. Some setups focus on overwhelming offensive power, while others prioritize defense, mobility, automated attacks, or specialized synergies. This flexibility ensures that no two runs feel exactly alike and gives players plenty of opportunities to discover powerful strategies that suit their preferred playstyle. Progression is another area where Geometry Arena 2 excels. The game features a large collection of upgrades and unlockables that gradually expand the player's options over time. Each run contributes toward future advancement, making even unsuccessful attempts feel worthwhile. The steady stream of new abilities, enhancements, and customization opportunities provides a constant sense of achievement. Players are encouraged to refine their builds, experiment with new combinations, and pursue increasingly ambitious goals as they grow stronger. The challenge system further enhances replayability by allowing players to adjust various modifiers that affect gameplay difficulty. Instead of relying solely on traditional difficulty settings, the game offers numerous ways to customize the experience. This approach makes the game accessible to newcomers while also providing veterans with opportunities to create extremely demanding scenarios. The result is a title that can remain enjoyable for dozens of hours because players have significant control over how they want to engage with its challenges. Another notable aspect is the inclusion of pets and auxiliary systems that actively participate in combat. These additions are more than simple cosmetic features and can play important roles in a successful build. Combined with the extensive upgrade system, they allow players to create highly specialized characters capable of generating devastating combinations. Watching a carefully planned build evolve into a screen-clearing force of destruction is one of the most rewarding parts of the entire experience. Despite its strengths, Geometry Arena 2 may not appeal equally to everyone. The large number of systems, statistics, upgrades, and customization options can feel intimidating at first, particularly for players unfamiliar with roguelite mechanics. Some may also find the lack of a traditional story or structured campaign less engaging compared to narrative-focused games. However, for players who enjoy progression-driven gameplay and experimenting with different builds, these aspects are unlikely to be significant drawbacks. What ultimately makes Geometry Arena 2 stand out is its ability to combine accessible arcade action with meaningful strategic depth. Every run offers opportunities to discover new combinations, overcome greater challenges, and refine increasingly powerful builds. The game succeeds in delivering the addictive cycle of experimentation, progression, and survival that defines the best entries in the genre. Its wealth of content, impressive customization systems, and satisfying combat make it an excellent choice for players seeking a highly replayable action experience. Rating: 8/10

[h1]8.5/10[/h1] [u]全成就+排行榜登顶，总耗时约17小时[/u]，总体游玩体验可以说是： [h2]麻雀虽小，五脏俱全。[/h2] 本作作为小体量类幸存者肉鸽游戏，画风简约但不简陋。清新朴素的几何美术配合动感十足的鼓点音乐，高辨识度的UI界面搭配轻快的打击感和击杀特效，看色彩饱满的几何体在碰撞与爆炸中从新生走向毁灭，自身机体却在狂风骤雨中不动如山，本作的游玩过程本身就带有一种由几何体构造的别具一格的割草爽感。 然而在简约的美术风格背后，我想着重讲讲本作有些[i]另类[/i]的肉鸽系统——[b]它破天荒的让我去思考“拿哪个buff没用”，而非拿哪个有用。(笑)[/b] 作为一款没有胜利可言的无限制肉鸽，本作的天赋成长依旧陷入了无限关卡带来的困境之中。游戏有六种武器和六种机体，不同武器与机体之间具有差异化的技能、攻击模组与强化方向，然而这种组件差异带来的流派特化仅仅被限制在了每一局游戏的前中期，而在游戏后期则是不可避免的百川归海到数值全能流和肉盾秒杀流两种流派。其根源在于游戏尴尬的数值逻辑，对于走数值全能流的流派而言，“增加50%”诸如此类的强化并非累乘与累加的复合，而是除去极少量几个降低生存能力的输出特化buff，其他几乎所有buff均是线性提升，而游戏中不断攀升的大数字则是由唯一性的乘区堆叠和机制联动铸就的，并且没有真正意义上“左脚踩右脚上天”的数值构筑，这使得在乘区竭尽后数值的变化就会到达某个软上线，成长开始疲软，渐渐跟不上敌人的增幅，这导致玩家哪怕穷尽了池子中几乎全部的输出buff依旧会在120-150层遗憾离场。 最终，在“打分”这一终极目标的驱动下，肉盾秒杀流这一特殊流派由于其完全不依赖乘区的特性脱颖而出，完美的诠释了拥有绝对强大的机制才是为王的理由。于是，在思考过后我选择屏蔽所有输出端的数值提升buff，利用前中期洁库，后期复选无尽幸运提升坦度和能量，通过毁灭者转化为体积提升，配合弹弹球、黑洞和挡板的碰撞秒杀机制，成功登顶排行榜。 针对这个问题，我其实建议制作组参考一下[i]《新星漂移》[/i]，同样是弹幕射击玩法的无限制竞技场肉鸽，也是多边形风格，甚至其中的一些流派和本作有异曲同工之意。但与本作不同的是，《新星漂移》融合了逆弹幕射击玩法，并通过多样化敌人设计、模块buff机制联动的互斥和保守的数值提升成功做到了不同流派差异化设计，最终产生了在高层数依旧百家争鸣的游戏深度，其玩法上和模块设计中的许多理念都值得本作去借鉴。 最后说一下优化上的问题，刚开始玩的时候很喜欢炮手，但打到100+层不知道是哪几个buff在抽风导致游戏帧率在不关特效时稳定在3帧左右，关了特效也只有20-30帧，打得很难受。其次是440+50层之后怪物刷新开始明显变慢，要过两三分钟才出一波怪，怀疑是bug或者是哪个数据溢出了导致关卡进度几乎卡住不动，冲榜时候被这个bug卡在这里了就退了，不然我怀疑肉盾秒杀流能干到1000层去。 [h2]总评：颇具爽感的小体量极简肉鸽[/h2] ++[b]爽感十足的割草体验[/b] +[b]简约大气的美术风格[/b] +[b]表意清晰的UI[/b] +[b]动感的BGM与清爽的音效[/b] -[b]让人略感惋惜的后期乏力[/b]

事实证明，在游戏性优秀的前提下，即使画面为极简风格也丝毫不会降低游戏的纯度，《几何竞技场2》就是这样一款纯粹的肉鸽幸存者游戏，不同于那些志在追求怪物、角色建模多样化、差异化的同类型游戏，本作将重心都放在了如何让游戏变得好玩上。 作为一款合格的肉鸽游戏，有出色明显的成长曲线：局内每过一关都会获取一个天赋，如增加子弹数量、提高射程射速；特殊一点的就是制造黑洞、每发射固定数量的子弹自动发射一次等。 局外则更为轻松，游戏打一局能升很多级，可以提升子弹射速等。角色性能不同，有的是快速射击，有的是发射榴弹，造成范围性爆炸伤害。同时都能携带不同的特性和宠物。 游戏的玩法就是老生常谈的类幸存者玩法，加之不错的射击手感和反馈，目前14块钱的价格，性价比可以说是很高了。 最后值得一提的是，游戏共有139个成就，游玩过程中往往一局就能解锁五六个成就，满足感这一块给到夯。 [quote]欢迎前来关注「 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/35307916/]品游拾光鉴赏组」 [/url] [u][b] 品味欢乐游戏，拾取快乐时光。[/b][/u][/quote]
